WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
), invoice_deviations AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price,
           avg_unit_price - AVG(avg_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
), country_averages AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation,
           AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_avg_deviation
    FROM invoice_deviations
)
SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_unit_price, deviation,
       deviation - country_avg_deviation AS deviation_minus_country_average
FROM country_averages
ORDER BY deviation_minus_country_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
